item: Windows and macOS observation legs: failures named as they happen, 65 of Windows shard 3's 84 fixed, the restore way-out flake (rows 103, 109)
summary: Row 103: the restore refusal's way-out restart test is ordered by events (the restore's real wait entered once the drain is in its finally, the drain let out once the restore read it running), never by a 0.3 s sleep against a 0.05 s wait; it fails when the restart's join is removed. Row 109: a Windows leg stopped at the 90-minute cap printed no failure reasons, so conftest writes each failed phase to OO_TEST_FAIL_REPORT as it ends and the step prints it. Of run 43924484775's 84 Windows shard 3 failures, 65 were readable and fixed: a CRLF checkout (now LF on every OS through .gitattributes; it made the vendored suffix list fail its digest on a Windows clone, so every off-site verdict read unknown_site), backup member names spelled with backslashes on Windows (now as_posix), the error journal now LF everywhere, POSIX-only modules and a pooled handle across a raw swap marked with reasons, child process encoding, SYSTEMROOT and loopback in the no-network guard. Two macOS timing tests judge state, not a clock. Held: the engine identity hashes backslash paths on Windows (fixing it re-indexes Windows libraries).
